output.brief:
Please don't switch the flag off and close the incident yet: it won't fix the crashes, and a full 7.4.0 release on Friday would roughly triple the crash rate for everyone.

Only 7.4.0 users can get Tiled Canvas, so "flag on" really means "on the new build". Build 7.4.0 was already crashing in about 2% of sessions on 2–3 Sep, before anyone had the flag, versus about 0.7% on 7.3.2. Among 7.4.0 users, those randomly kept off the flag crash at 1.98% against 2.10% with it: a small gap that could be noise. Device mix and usage are alike across groups. The app store's own crash counts, separate from our crash tool, show the same 2.04% vs 0.69%, so the gap is real. The biggest cluster (41% of 7.4.0 crash events) is a native crash in the upgraded image library, Pixelda, absent from 7.3.2. The sync-service deploy didn't move 7.3.2.

Next: hold 7.4.0 at 25% and fix the Pixelda crash. Keep the flag and its off-group running (optionally widen the group to measure any small flag effect). Don't roll back the crash-reporting upgrade.

I'm confident about the build cause; the flag's small effect is unresolved.
